parts.label: Part 1
parts.name: Listening — Choose the best reply
parts.rubric: Questions 1 – 6. You will hear six short sentences. For each one, choose the best reply. You will hear each sentence twice.

opts: The bus leaves in three minutes.
What time’s the next bus to London?
It’s stop 4, near the ticket office.
Oh, OK, I’ll do it then.

parts.label: Part 2
parts.name: Vocabulary — Parts of a house
parts.rubric: Questions 7 – 12. Choose the word to match the picture. For questions 7 – 12 write the correct letter, A – G.

parts.label: Part 3
parts.name: Prepositions of place
parts.rubric: Questions 13 – 18. Read the sentences about places. Choose the best answer, A, B or C, for each space.

qs.text: I left my phone a train.
Let’s meet for lunch a restaurant.
Could you meet me the airport, please?
Laura’s work now so please call later.
I’m having breakfast in the garden but Paul’s still bed.

parts.label: Part 4
parts.name: Reading — Email about a holiday
parts.rubric: Questions 19 – 24. Read the email about a holiday in Colombia. Choose the best answer, A, B or C, for each space.

passage.title: On holiday in Colombia
passage.html:
From: Anna
To: Mimi
On holiday in Colombia

Hi Mimi

Hello from sunny Colombia! How are you? Are you at home today or (19) ……………? I hope you’re well. Our holiday here in Colombia is great. Colombia is a beautiful country and the people are really friendly.

Right now, (20) …………… in a café, drinking a coffee. The weather was cloudy here yesterday, but today it’s warm and sunny, and (21) ……………. That’s good because I don’t like rain!

The café is on the beach, so (22) …………… this email and I can see the sea at the same time. There are lots of people on the beach and some people (23) ……………. It’s a great view.

We arrived in this town yesterday. We came by bus, which took four hours. (24) …………… in a hotel because it’s quite expensive, so we’re in a hostel for three nights. It’s lovely.

See you soon
Anna

parts.label: Part 5
parts.name: Here and now
parts.rubric: Questions 25 – 30. Read the sentences about here and now. Choose the best answer, A, B or C, for each space.

qs.text: I’ll call you later, we having dinner now.
Hurry up, for you at the bus stop.
Sandro cooking dinner at the moment.
now – why don’t we sit in the garden?
Sarah, what at the moment?
I today because it’s the weekend.
